questions.question: What are the two birds featured in this year's Deepavali light-up called?
questions.snippet: This year, the Deepavali light-up features two birds flanking the Happy Deepavali greeting in English and Tamil. The birds are Indian celestial swans known as “annapatchi”.

questions.question: Who officially opened the new SilverCare Hub in Tampines?
questions.answer: Finance Minister and Tampines GRC MP Heng Swee Keat
questions.snippet: The hub, which was officially opened by Finance Minister and Tampines GRC MP Heng Swee Keat,

questions.question: Which four organizations partnered to establish the SilverCare Hub?
questions.answer: Changi General Hospital, St Andrew’s Senior Care, Eastern Community Health Centre, and Tampines Family Medicine Clinic
questions.snippet: is a partnership between CGH, St Andrew’s Senior Care (Tampines), the Eastern Commu- nity Health Centre and the Tampines Family Medicine Clinic.

questions.question: How many medical conditions will the GPNext scheme initially cover?
questions.snippet: GPNext will initially cover 14 medical conditions, such as lower back pain, asthma and urinary tract infection.

questions.question: How many partner GPs are involved in the Community Right Siting Programme today?
questions.snippet: Under the Community Right Sit- ing Programme, the number of partner GPs has increased from 10 in 2014 to 120 today.

questions.question: What is the eventual goal of the SilverCare Hub's rehabilitation and treatment services for seniors?
questions.answer: Returning them back to health and active ageing
questions.snippet: The message is clear – we want to rehabilitate and provide treat- ment to our seniors with the even- tual goal of returning them back to health and active ageing.
